verdict.rationale: Box has a comprehensive, well-documented public REST API (base URL, OAuth, endpoints for uploads, search, metadata, webhooks, events, collaborations, shared links) with reference docs, developer tokens, and a working llms.txt discovery file, plus SDKs. This clearly enables an AI-native user to drive Box programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and stronger independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
